g.text: The interface compares the requested parameters with those Galaxy validated or recorded
After a request was blocked for a different value, the run later completed a job of the same tool in 71% of 1,700 cases
(with matching parameters in 52%). Matching parameters do not show that the settings were scientifically appropriate.

g.text: Failed requests and candidate infrastructure improvements
Failure classes grouped by the change most likely to help (codebook in Source Data); an independent rater
reproduced 92% of the classes and named the same improvement for 71% of requests
